english: What remarkable achievement did Javed Miandad accomplish on the last ball during the 1986 Austral-Asia Cup played in Sharjah?
roman_1: Sharjah mein khele gaye 1986 ke Australasia Cup ke doran Javed Miandad ne aakhri ball par kya kaarnama sar anjaam diya?
